tools.name: attach_site_domain
tools.description: Attach a custom hostname to a Namepiq Site. Prefer a domain owned in the user's Namepiq account so DNS is updated automatically. Idempotent. After success, wait and poll (get_dns / public resolution / HTTPS) for up to ~5 minutes — do not immediately set_dns to force publish; SystemDNS lag is normal.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start paid domain checkout via Razorpay Payment Link. Returns payment_url for the human to pay, then poll get_checkout_status. Requires verified email + saved contact. Confirm with the user before calling. items: [{domain, years?, auto_renew?, include_hosting?}]. Hosting is shown as integer /mo (e.g

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a domain (authenticated).

tools.name: create_hosting_checkout
tools.description: Buy +1 Sites hosting slot for one year via Razorpay Payment Link (extra site without a domain cart). Returns payment_url — show the human, then poll get_checkout_status. Confirm first. Requires verified email. Shown /mo, charged yearly. Free SSL + CDN. If checkout_in_progress, ask before abandon_pen

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create a Namepiq Sites project (static hosting). Requires an active hosting slot (list_sites → hosting.sites_remaining, or buy via create_checkout include_hosting / create_hosting_checkout). Returns hosting_required (402) if no slots. Then call deploy_site with an https ZIP URL.

tools.name: create_watch
tools.description: Create a free domain watch (limits apply). For paid tiers use create_watch_checkout.

tools.name: create_watch_checkout
tools.description: Start paid watch checkout via Razorpay Payment Link. Returns payment_url for the human. tier: standard|priority. Then poll get_watch_checkout_status.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete own comment on a domain.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Delete a Namepiq Site and its published files. Frees a slot for create_site (quota is count of sites vs entitlements).

tools.name: delete_watch
tools.description: Delete/abandon a watch by UUID.

tools.name: deploy_site
tools.description: Deploy a static site ZIP via Namepiq Sites. Pass site_id from create_site and artifact_url (https URL to a ZIP of HTML/CSS/JS — no Node/PHP server apps). Public URL appears after attach_site_domain.

tools.name: get_checkout_status
tools.description: Poll checkout/payment + fulfillment status after create_checkout. Pass checkout_id or razorpay_order_id.

tools.name: get_dns
tools.description: Get managed DNS records for an owned domain.

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Get one owned domain by UUID.

tools.name: get_geo
tools.description: Infer likely country/currency from the request edge. Call before search or quote when currency is unknown.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Return the authenticated user profile and default contact (requires login or NAMEPIQ_TOKEN).

tools.name: get_nameservers
tools.description: Read nameservers for an owned domain.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Get one Namepiq Site by UUID (status, custom domains, public primary_url when a domain is attached).

tools.name: get_watch_checkout_status
tools.description: Poll paid watch status after create_watch_checkout.

tools.name: hosting_prices
tools.description: Public hosting price for one Sites slot. Shown as integer /mo (amount_display / monthly_display) but billed annually (yearly_minor ×1 year). Pass currency (USD, INR, …). Call before offering include_hosting or create_hosting_checkout.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List public comments on a domain page.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List domains owned by the authenticated account.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List Namepiq Sites plus hosting quota (hosting.site_slots, sites_used, sites_remaining) and hosting_price for the shopper currency. Use sites_remaining before create_site.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List domain watches for the authenticated account.

tools.name: login
tools.description: DEPRECATED for chat agents: email/password auth. Prefer start_device_login + poll_device_login so the human signs in via browser (supports Google). Avoid putting passwords in chat.

tools.name: patch_me
tools.description: Update account prefs (e.g. country, preferred_currency).

tools.name: poll_device_login
tools.description: Poll once after start_device_login. Call this repeatedly every ~5s right after start_device_login (do not wait for the human to say they approved). Returns authorization_pending (keep polling), slow_down (wait longer), or authorized with access_token stored for this MCP session. Prefer this over the

tools.name: push_domain_contacts
tools.description: Push the account default contact to the registry for this domain (owner/admin/billing/tech).

tools.name: quote_domain
tools.description: Get a multi-year retail quote for an exact domain (1, 2, 3, or 5 years). Optional ISO currency. Prefer amount_display; amount_minor is ISO 4217 minor units. Read-only research only.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Create a Namepiq account. Returns access_token and stores it for this session. User must verify email before checkout.

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Ops/reseller path: register charging the reseller balance (no end-user Razorpay). For shoppers prefer create_checkout + payment_url. Confirm with the user before calling.

tools.name: renew_domain
tools.description: Renew an owned domain for additional years.

tools.name: resend_verification
tools.description: Resend the email verification link (requires login).

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Check domain availability and retail list prices for a query or FQDN. Optional ISO currency (USD, EUR, INR, …). Prefer amount_display in replies; amount_minor is ISO 4217 minor units for that currency. Read-only research only.

tools.name: set_dns
tools.description: Replace managed DNS zone records for an owned domain. Pass records as returned by get_dns (array of record objects). Do not use this to force-republish after attach_site_domain — wait/poll up to ~5 minutes for SystemDNS instead; use sync_site_domain_dns only if the CNAME is still missing after that.

tools.name: set_nameservers
tools.description: Replace nameservers for an owned domain (unlock may be required).

tools.name: start_device_login
tools.description: Preferred sign-in for MCP (including Google accounts). Returns verification_uri_complete and user_code. REQUIRED agent behavior: (1) show the human verification_uri_complete once, (2) immediately begin calling poll_device_login every ~5s until authorized/denied/expired — do not wait for the human to

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Suggest domain names for a brand or keyword. Optional comma-separated tlds override. Read-only research only.

tools.name: sync_site_domain_dns
tools.description: Re-apply managed DNS for an already-attached hostname. Use only if attach reported DNS failure, or after waiting ~5 minutes DNS is still wrong. Prefer waiting over calling this immediately; do not use set_dns for the same purpose.

tools.name: top_watched
tools.description: Top watched domains (public).

tools.name: update_domain
tools.description: Update lock and/or auto-renew flags on an owned domain.

tools.name: upsert_contact
tools.description: Create/update the account's default registrant contact used for registrations.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Verify email with the token from the verification email link (query ?token=).

tools.name: watch_prices
tools.description: Paid watch tier prices in a currency (standard ~$1, priority ~$5, 1 month each).

tools.name: watch_status
tools.description: Public watch interest status for a domain.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_comments · Private data: create_checkout, delete_site, get_dns, get_me, login, poll_device_login, push_domain_contacts, set_dns, start_device_login, upsert_contact, verify_email · Public sink: attach_site_domain, create_checkout, create_comment, create_hosting_checkout, login, register, resend_verification, verify_email · Destructive: delete_comment, delete_site, delete_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_comments · Private data: create_checkout, delete_site, get_dns, get_me, login, poll_device_login, push_domain_contacts, set_dns, start_device_login, upsert_contact, verify_email · Public sink: attach_site_domain, create_checkout, create_comment, create_hosting_checkout, login, register, resend_verification, verify_email · Destructive: delete_comment, delete_site, delete_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
